job.title: Senior AI Full-Stack Engineers - Build the MVP for Vex AI
job.description:
Hi everyone,

We're getting ready to launch Vex AI, a brand new web platform designed from the ground up to let everyday users such as freelancers, small business owners, marketing teams, consultants, and product managers easily create and run their own teams of autonomous AI agents that actually collaborate with one another in a way that feels exactly like working with a real human team.

Here's exactly what the product will do once it's live and available to users around the world. After signing up and creating their workspace, users will be able to build multiple specialized agents tailored to their specific needs. For example, someone running a content marketing campaign could create a Research Agent that goes out and searches the web while also reading through their own uploaded documents to pull in the absolute latest and most relevant data. They could then add an Analysis Agent that takes all of that gathered information and transforms it into clear structured insights, professional charts, and actionable recommendations. A Writing Agent would produce polished articles, emails, or social media posts in the users own voice, while a Scheduling Agent would automatically book meetings, send follow-up emails, and keep calendars perfectly updated. Finally, a Review Agent would carefully check every output for accuracy and suggest meaningful improvements before anything reaches the user. 

These agents will communicate with each other automatically in the background, handing off tasks smoothly, catching and correcting mistakes on their own, and continuing to work until the entire goal is fully completed without the user having to micromanage every step. The entire system connects directly to the users own files, Google Drive folders, Notion pages, calendars, email accounts, and any external APIs they choose to add. What makes this truly special is that the agents build persistent memory across sessions and projects so they remember past work, learn the users unique style and preferences over time, and become noticeably smarter and more efficient with every use. From the users perspective the whole experience stays simple, clean, and intuitive, but underneath it runs on advanced multi-agent orchestration, powerful persistent memory systems, and extremely capable tool-use features that handle complex real-world workflows with almost no supervision.

This isn't just another basic chatbot or simple automation tool that you see everywhere these days. We're building a complete autonomous intelligence platform that can genuinely handle sophisticated, multi-step processes that professionals deal with every single day. Our clear goal is to position Vex AI as the daily operating system that thousands of professionals worldwide will come to rely on to get serious work done faster, smarter, and with far less effort.

Right now we are looking to find and bring on 5 strong senior AI full-stack engineers to build and deliver the complete, production-ready MVP that will serve as the solid foundation for everything that comes next. 

Important note: the full, highly detailed technical specifications, complete architecture diagrams, exact feature priority list, all security requirements, and the entire product roadmap will be shared only after we sign a mutual NDA together. This step is completely non-negotiable because we're protecting several genuinely novel approaches to agent collaboration, memory management, and intelligent planning that we strongly believe will give Vex AI a real competitive edge in the market. Once the NDA is signed we'll move extremely fast and efficiently.

The MVP must be fully functional, secure, scalable, and ready for the first wave of real users on day one. You'll own every part of it end-to-end, starting with the complete user onboarding and workspace system that includes smooth sign-up flows, email verification, and an easy onboarding experience. This extends to supporting multiple workspaces per user along with team invites and full role-based access control so that growing teams can work together seamlessly. You'll also build the agent creation and management studio, which is a visual interface that lets users create new agents, choose their specializations, set clear goals, and configure personality and memory settings exactly the way they want. Inside this studio there'll be a full agent library where users can duplicate, share, or version-control their agents with ease.

The real-time multi-modal conversation interface will be modern and polished, supporting long-running conversations that can involve multiple agents working together at the same time. Text input will be the primary method, but the architecture will already be fully prepared for voice input and output so we can add those features quickly in future phases. Users will see live streaming of agent thoughts, tool calls, and final outputs so they always know exactly what is happening behind the scenes. 

You'll also implement the advanced RAG and knowledge system that handles document uploads in all common formats such as PDF, Word, text files, spreadsheets, and images. This system will automatically parse, chunk, embed, and store everything intelligently while providing context-aware retrieval that truly understands what the user is asking for. It will support both per-agent knowledge bases and workspace-level ones so users have maximum flexibility. 

The multi-agent orchestration engine is at the heart of the product. It will allow agents to break down complex tasks, create detailed step-by-step plans, delegate subtasks to the right agents, execute tools when needed, self-correct when things go wrong, and report back with complete results. We're open to using LangGraph or CrewAI depending on which one you can strongly defend as the best technical choice for this scale. The system will include a supervisor agent pattern with a human-in-the-loop fallback so nothing ever gets completely stuck.

Persistent memory and context management will be built deeply into the platform with short-term conversation memory, long-term vector-based memory that spans all sessions and projects, and user preference memory that improves automatically over time so the agents feel more and more personalized. 

The tool integration layer will come with several powerful built-in tools including web search, code interpreter, calendar read and write functions, email sending and receiving, and file system access. At the same time, we'll provide an easy configuration method so users can quickly add their own custom API tools whenever they need them. 

The full user dashboard and analytics section will give users a clear overview of all their agents and active workflows, complete conversation history with powerful search and filtering options, and detailed performance metrics along with cost tracking and usage analytics for every agent and every workspace. 

Finally, the production infrastructure must be rock solid. This includes secure authentication using Clerk or Supabase Auth, payments integration already prepared with Stripe, a complete set of REST and WebSocket APIs with full documentation, a well-designed PostgreSQL database with proper indexing and schema, and deployment on Vercel for the frontend combined with AWS for the backend using Docker, full CI/CD pipelines, logging, error tracking through Sentry, and comprehensive monitoring. We'll also have rate limiting, security headers, and the basic foundation for compliance already in place. Everything you write must be clean, maintainable, and extremely well documented because we'll be building on this foundation continuously for a very long time.

Tech Stack (non-negotiable core but we're open to strong justification if you have even better modern alternatives) includes Next.js 15 with the App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui for the frontend. On the backend we prefer Python plus FastAPI but Node.js and Express are also acceptable. The AI layer will use the latest models through OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq. Orchestration will be handled by LangGraph or CrewAI. The vector database can be PGVector, Pinecone, or Weaviate. The main database is PostgreSQL. Authentication is Clerk or Supabase Auth. Deployment will be Vercel for the frontend plus AWS for the backend with a complete CI/CD pipeline.

Budget and Payment Terms
We've set aside a serious budget specifically to attract the very best talent available anywhere in the world. The fixed-price option for the complete MVP delivered by the team of 5 is between 150000 and 220000 USD, with the final amount decided after we review your proposed architecture and overall experience. 

The payment schedule is flexible and can be adjusted to what works best for the team, but a typical example would be 25 percent deposit after the NDA and technical call, 25 percent after the core infrastructure and authentication are complete, 25 percent after the agent creation and RAG system are fully working, and the final 25 percent after the complete multi-agent orchestration and final testing plus deployment are all finished. We pay promptly on every milestone approval with no exceptions ever.

This MVP represents only Phase 1 of the journey. We're fully committed to continuous long-term product development. Once the MVP is live and we begin receiving real user feedback, we'll immediately start Phase 2 and many phases after that, adding scaling improvements, more advanced tools, mobile support, enterprise features, deeper analytics, and whatever else the product needs to grow into a major platform. We're actively looking for a true long-term technical partner who will stay with Vex AI as it evolves and expands over the coming years.

Timeline
We're targeting a realistic 8 to 12 weeks from the official kickoff date to a full production-ready MVP, and we'll have weekly progress updates along with milestone demos so everyone stays perfectly aligned at all times.

Who Can Apply and How We Choose
This opportunity is open to absolutely anyone in the world with the right skills.

We'll be extremely strict in selection. We only want people who are clearly prepared and serious about delivering world-class work. To apply, please send:
1. Direct links to 2 to 3 of your strongest AI full-stack projects. For each one, tell us exactly what you built, which parts you owned, and what technical challenges you solved (especially anything involving agents, RAG, memory, or multi-agent systems).
2. A concise proposal (maximum 700 words) explaining how you would architect and deliver this exact MVP.
3. Your current availability.

We'll review every serious application, conduct a technical discussion, and give a small paid evaluation task to the shortlisted candidates. We plan to select the final team of 5 from the best submissions.

If you get excited by the idea of building something that real professionals will use every single day, and you want to be part of a long-term journey as we turn Vex AI into a globally recognized platform, then please apply now.

We're ready to sign the NDA and start immediately once we find the right team.

Looking forward to reading your answers.
